title: Training Notes — Repeat Estimated Water Reads and the Estimate Share on the Utility Pass-Through Service
content:
**Rule.** When an estimated water read is set on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, an account with two or more estimated water reads taken in the last twelve months has its estimate set at 85 percent of the converted figure, and an account with exactly one such read at 93 percent. An account with no estimated water read taken in the last twelve months takes no share under this rule.

**Counting.** An estimated water read counts as taken in the last twelve months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its read date from the handling date. The share multiplies the estimated consumption as converted to the cycle, before the final figure is rounded half up to the hundredth of a thousand gallons.

## Questions answered

**Q. What is counted?** Water reads of the type "estimated" already on the account, by their read date, within the last 12 months.

**Q. Which share applies to how many earlier estimates?**

| Estimated water reads taken in the last 12 months | Estimate set at |
|---|---|
| 0 | no share under this rule |
| 1 | 93 percent of the converted figure |
| 2 | 85 percent of the converted figure |
| 3 or more | 85 percent of the converted figure |

**Q. An estimated read dated exactly twelve whole months before the handling date — does it count?** No. Twelve whole months is not fewer than twelve; a read dated one day later than that counts.

**Q. Worked through (hypothetical).** Converted figure 4.20 kgal; one earlier estimated water read in the last 12 months. 4.20 times 93 percent is 3.906, recorded after rounding as 3.91 kgal. With two earlier estimated reads: 4.20 times 85 percent is 3.57 kgal.
